links.note: Was 24117 Majority and minority. Keys 'All of the above' across Saudi women barred from public life, renewed LTTE violence, and money and muscle power at elections - the challenge-to-democracy taxonomy of the removed Challenges to Democracy chapter, which has no row in standard 43. None of this chapter's 16 outcome concepts is a taxonomy of challenges.
Was 24117. Explicitly about the 'Challenge of Expansion', a term that exists only in Challenges to Democracy. Nothing in the outcomes frame names it.

Was 24114 Concentration of wealth. This is a Challenges-to-Democracy classification item - a Bolivian scenario whose four options are Foundational challenge / Challenge of democracy / Deepening of democracy / None, keyed to 'Deepening of democracy'. It is not about wealth distribution at all.

Was 24113 Political equality and economic inequality. A Nepal scenario keyed to 'Foundational challenge' - the same Challenges-to-Democracy classification exercise as qid:105699. No inequality content.

Was 24119 Expectations keep rising. Asks which statement is wrong under the 'expanded definition' of democracy (elected rulers decide, fair choice, equal basis, government limited by the Constitution and citizens' rights). That definition is the Challenges chapter's recap of Class 9's What is Democracy, not an outcome of democracy.
Was 24118 Dignity of the individual. 'The idea of promoting one's region is known as' - regionalism. Not discussed in Outcomes of Democracy under any of its 16 concepts.

Was 24109 Legitimate government. Keys that democratic reforms come about principally through political practice - the reform argument that closes Challenges to Democracy. This chapter has no reform concept; legitimacy is not what the item tests.
